create.name: Megan Riley
create.bio:
Megan Riley teaches traditional Mysore-style Ashtanga yoga in Utrecht, where she runs Ashtanga Yoga Center Utrecht. She first took up Ashtanga in the United States while beginning a career in higher education, partly as a way to bring her philosophy reading into lived practice. That led her to a first teacher and then to Mysore in India, and in time she left university teaching for the practice room. After years of study there she was given Certification by R. Sharath Jois, and she has assisted in his teaching room, taught at Jois Shala in the US and ran her own Mysore programme in Connecticut before moving to the Netherlands.

Her weekday mornings are self-paced Mysore practice in a room inside the Yoga Moves Fly building, a short walk from Utrecht Central station, where beginners and long-standing students work through the sequence at their own pace with individual help. On Saturdays she leads the Primary Series as a counted class at a second location, and from time to time she offers a one-hour introduction for complete newcomers. The shala keeps the tradition's rest days on Sundays and on new and full moons. In her teaching she asks students to meet themselves as they are each day while noticing long-held habits of body and mind.

courses.title: Mysore Class Passes
courses.description: Passes for the weekday Mysore room in Utrecht, which also cover the Saturday led class. Options run from a single class to monthly unlimited practice, with a lower rate for full-time students and an introductory month for newcomers.
courses.price: Unlimited pass/30 days – €135; 8 class pass/30 days – €99; 10 class pass/90 days – €150; Single class – €20; Unlimited pass for full-time enrolled students/30 days – €80; New students: 1 month unlimited mornings for €80

courses.title: Daily Mysore Programme and Saturday Led Primary
courses.description: Self-paced Mysore practice from Monday to Friday between six and quarter to nine in the morning, open to complete beginners, plus a counted Primary Series class on Saturdays for students who already know part of the sequence. Bookings go through the schedule page; walk-ins are also accepted.

free_resources.title: How Do I Get Started?
free_resources.description: A short free guide for newcomers explaining how a Mysore morning works when there is no fixed start time, how passes are activated and why no previous yoga experience is needed.
